// census-want: 1
// Fremd-Review 1 F-2 probe: the sub-block helper starts the block call
// (a blockFunc value) as a goroutine and hands its lease back.
package oai

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/dispatch"
)

func (r subBlockRun) first(lease *dispatch.Lease, runCtx context.Context, do blockFunc) {
	go do(0, 1, lease, runCtx)
	lease.Release()
}
